verdict.rationale: Every Supabase project is a full managed Postgres database with instant auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs. The documented API-key model separates client access (publishable key, gated by RLS, for browser and mobile) from server access (secret key, for servers and Edge Functions), and llms.txt lists per-language SDK references (JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python, C#). Community users describe it as great for spinning up CRUD apps. missing for 10: an explicitly quoted client-SDK read/write (select/insert) example, and independent hands-on corroboration of server-SDK data access specifically.
